description: Aggregated appointment waiting days by county, month and clinic stop code for Veterans Health Administration and Community Care.
name: US Veterans Health Administration appointment wait times

recipe.reason: The county-level file has 14,365,643 rows, so even the id alone passes the importer's cell limit (a mapped column would hold twice that many cells), and 8,264 of its rows have unquoted commas in the state and county names of the armed forces entries, which the csv-table parser refuses at line 1892.
